name: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa
positioning: Cottage resort in Bermuda, welcoming guests since 1923, with four private beaches and two private coves on Mangrove Bay
best_for: Beach lovers who want private beaches and coves on site
Families or groups wanting multi-bedroom cottages or a private residence
Travelers who want water sports and spa time without leaving the resort

facts.text: Cambridge Beaches has welcomed guests for oceanfront escapes since 1923.
Every accommodation has a private entrance, a dedicated outdoor seating area and views.
Water View Rooms feature bespoke furniture and artwork by Bermudian artists.
King's Point is a five-bedroom private residence on a 4.5-acre peninsula, with butler and housekeeping services.
The Aquarian Baths inside the Ocean Spa have an indoor pool, a jacuzzi, a sauna, a steam room, a crystal therapy room and a cold-rain shower.
Ocean Spa uses Caudalie products in all of its treatments.
Ocean Spa offers organic Irish seaweed rituals from VOYA.
Long Bay Beach is the longest of the four private beaches and a vantage point for sunsets.
Oleander Cycles, on site, rents scooters, e-bikes and electric vehicles.
The resort has a tennis court, pickleball and a basketball court.
Sunken Harbor Club is the Bermuda chapter of the cocktail bar created by St. John Frizell, run as a dockside tavern and tropical cocktail bar.
Breezes is an alfresco oceanside restaurant serving lunch and dinner, where longtail birds, grey herons and even sea turtles may be sighted.

highlights.text: The resort has four private beaches and two private coves.
Private Pool Water View Cottages have a private swim-up plunge pool overlooking the Atlantic Ocean or Mangrove Bay.
King's Point was once the home of Bermudian explorer Teddy Tucker.
An infinity-edge pool overlooks Mangrove Bay.
H2O Sports, on site, rents kayaks, paddleboards, sailboats and motorboats for exploring coves, coral reefs and shipwrecks just offshore.

considerations.text: The resort is not ADA accessible.
Ocean Spa treatments are for guests aged 16 and over.
Downtown Hamilton is a 30-minute ferry ride away.
